add_node_to_registry: add a new remote meet node with a name, websocket url, and auth token to the NodeRegistry
get_node_from_registry: get a specific node entry by name from the NodeRegistry file-backed JSON store
remove_node_from_registry: remove a named node from the NodeRegistry and return True if it existed
list_all_nodes: list all registered remote meet nodes sorted alphabetically by name from the NodeRegistry
resolve_chrome_node: resolve a chrome_node name to its url and token or auto-resolve when exactly one node is registered
